# `k.drag`

Import each declaration by name, for example `import k.drag.Draggable`.

| Declaration | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`Draggable`](#draggable) | Makes its content draggable with a pointer (mouse, pen or touch) and with the keyboard, carrying a typed payload to any [`DropTarget`](#droptarget) of the same kind (`docs/design/41-drag-and-drop.md`). |
| [`DragKind`](#dragkind) | What can be dragged, paired with the type of its payload: `DragKind<CardDrag> = DragKind(name: "card")` (`docs/design/41-drag-and-drop.md`). |
| [`DragTokens`](#dragtokens) | The theme tokens `k.drag` declares, with defaults. |
| [`DropTarget`](#droptarget) | A region that accepts drags of one kind and fires `dropped` with their payload (`docs/design/41-drag-and-drop.md`). |
| [`ListMove`](#listmove) | An item dropped on a [`ReorderableList`](#reorderablelist), as its `moved` event delivers it (`docs/design/41-drag-and-drop.md`). |
| [`ReorderableList`](#reorderablelist) | A list whose items can be reordered, and moved to and from other reorderable lists of the same kind, with a pointer, touch or the keyboard (`docs/design/41-drag-and-drop.md`). |

## Draggable

```k,ignore
public component Draggable<T>
```

Makes its content draggable with a pointer (mouse, pen or touch) and
with the keyboard, carrying a typed payload to any [`DropTarget`](#droptarget) of
the same kind (`docs/design/41-drag-and-drop.md`).

The content is focusable. Space or Enter picks it up, the arrow keys
choose a drop target, Space or Enter drops and Escape cancels, each step
announced in a live region. A touch drag starts after a short press, so
a swipe still scrolls.

## DragKind

```k,ignore
public struct DragKind<T>
```

What can be dragged, paired with the type of its payload:
`DragKind<CardDrag> = DragKind(name: "card")`
(`docs/design/41-drag-and-drop.md`). A drop target or a reorderable
list accepts only drags of its own kind, so a drop handler always
receives the payload type it declares. The name is a string literal;
kinds with the same name are the same kind.

**Members**

- `init(name: String)`
  Creates the kind named `name`.

  - Parameter name: a string literal; kinds with the same name are the
    same kind.
- `var name: String`
  The kind's name.

## DragTokens

```k,ignore
public theme DragTokens
```

The theme tokens `k.drag` declares, with defaults. An app overrides
them with the assignment form in its own theme
(`dropIndicator = #16A34A`).

**Members**

- `color dropIndicator: Color = #2563EB`
  The color of the line that shows where a dragged item will land in
  a [`ReorderableList`](#reorderablelist).
- `color dropTarget: Color = #93C5FD`
  The outline color of a [`DropTarget`](#droptarget) while an accepted drag is over
  it.

## DropTarget

```k,ignore
public component DropTarget<T>
```

A region that accepts drags of one kind and fires `dropped` with their
payload (`docs/design/41-drag-and-drop.md`).

`accepts` refines the kind with a rule on the payload: a payload it
rejects can't be dropped here, with the pointer or the keyboard. While
an accepted drag is over the region it carries the `data-k-drop-target`
attribute and the `dropTarget` token's outline.

**Members**

- `@Slot let content: View @Prop let kind: DragKind<T> @Prop let label: String @Prop let accepts: (T) -> Bool =`
  The content of the region.
  The [`DragKind`](#dragkind) of the drags accepted.
  The region's name, announced while a drag is over it ("Trash").
  The accept rule: `true` for a payload that may be dropped here.
  Every payload of the kind by default.

## ListMove

```k,ignore
public struct ListMove<T>
```

An item dropped on a [`ReorderableList`](#reorderablelist), as its `moved` event
delivers it (`docs/design/41-drag-and-drop.md`).

**Members**

- `let item: T`
  The item that moved.
- `let fromList: String`
  The [`ReorderableList.id`](#reorderablelist) of the list it came from.
- `let fromIndex: Int`
  Its position in that list.
- `let toList: String`
  The [`ReorderableList.id`](#reorderablelist) of the list it was dropped on.
- `let toIndex: Int`
  Its position in that list, counted after removing it from its own
  list: remove it, then insert it there.

## ReorderableList

```k,ignore
public component ReorderableList<T>
```

A list whose items can be reordered, and moved to and from other
reorderable lists of the same kind, with a pointer, touch or the
keyboard (`docs/design/41-drag-and-drop.md`).

It renders a `list` named `label` with one `item` per element of
`items`, drawn by the chained `row` slot and kept by `key` like
`for … key`.
The list doesn't move anything itself: a drop fires `moved` on the
list that receives the item, and the app changes its state, which
redraws both lists.

Keyboard: Space or Enter on a focused item picks it up, ArrowUp and
ArrowDown choose its position, ArrowLeft and ArrowRight the previous or
next list of the same kind, Space or Enter drops and Escape cancels;
every step is announced in a live region.

**Members**

- `@Slot let row: (T) -> View @Prop let kind: DragKind<T> @Prop let id: String @Prop let items: List<T> @Prop let key: (T) -> String @Prop let label: String @Prop let itemLabel: (T) -> String =`
  Draws one item.
  The [`DragKind`](#dragkind) the list's items are dragged as, and the kind it
  accepts.
  Identifies the list in a [`ListMove`](#listmove) ("todo", a column's id).
  The items, in order.
  Each item's identity: rows are kept by it, like `for … key`.
  The list's accessible name, announced while an item is over it.
  Each item's name in announcements ("Write tests"); its key when the
  name is empty, as it is by default.
- `@Prop let accepts: (T) -> Bool =`
  The accept rule for items coming from another list. Every item of
  the kind by default.
